items.title: Weekly Dars-e-Quran: Surah Al-Jinn
items.summary: Every Saturday, 9:00 – 10:00 pm at City of Knowledge — with Du'a Hizb al-Bahr and Mehfil-e-Durood.
items.content:
The weekly Dars-e-Quran at City of Knowledge is now on Surah Al-Jinn.

Every Saturday, 9:00 – 10:00 pm, followed by Du'a Hizb al-Bahr and a Mehfil of Durood-o-Salam. Families are welcome; a separate arrangement is made for women.

City of Knowledge, B-105, 13D/1, Gulshan-e-Iqbal, Karachi

items.title: New lectures on Shaykh Abdul Qadir Jilani
items.summary: What Imam al-Dhahabi, Ibn Taymiyyah and Ibn Arabi wrote about Ghaus-e-Azam — new videos on YouTube.
items.content:
A new set of lectures by Dr. Umair Mahmood Siddiqui on Shaykh Abdul Qadir Jilani:
• Shaykh Abdul Qadir Jilani and Imam al-Dhahabi — https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cD7_pTbXP24
• Ibn Taymiyyah on Shaykh Abdul Qadir Jilani — https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y187n8xABu8
• Sirr al-Asrar & Futuh al-Ghaib — https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4Q3EQXtMACk
• What Ibn Arabi says about Ghaus-e-Azam — https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XyC7D1v11fE
